title: Sentinels of Ether: reverse-engineered craft need psionic assets to fly

tellings.quote: Like getting that to fly requires the psionic assets to lock in again on the ground

plain: Craft rebuilt from recovered unknown vehicles can only be flown, Michels says, if "psionic assets", people with psychic abilities, lock in on them from the ground. He says this himself, crediting a work called Sentinels of Ether and citing a man named Jake Barber, in an episode with a guest who says he was taken into the UFO programme as a child. If true, mind and machine would have to work together for these craft to fly.
